subject: Proposal: latency SLA token boost & trial extension
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena@finspire.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Production latency spike tonight — request for compensation

Jordan —

We saw a severe increase in tail latency across our production region between 01:10–01:38 PT last night. Several checkout requests timed out and our ops dashboard shows retries spiking. This caused customer-facing errors for ~12 minutes and impacted an A/B cohort.

We need:
- an incident timeline and root cause once you have it
- a proposal for remediation and a goodwill gesture (token/top-up or trial extension) while you investigate

Attaching our incident log excerpt for your reference (incident_log-may14.csv). Please escalate — this affected a revenue flow.

—Elena
Elena Soto
Head of Platform Ops, Finspire
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Soto <elena@finspire.com>
Date: 2027-05-14T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Production latency spike tonight — request for compensation

Looping you both in — Finspire hit a latency regression that caused customer errors for ~12m. They asked for an incident timeline and a goodwill gesture to offset impact.

Suggested quick offer (pending your input):
- Immediate 5k token boost applied to Finspire account
- 10-day trial extension on top of their current trial window
- Postmortem delivery within 72 hours and 1-on-1 review

Can engineering confirm the timeline and whether 5k tokens is reasonable as a conservative first offer? Stephanie — will this meet CRO expectations or do you want to move larger?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Elena Soto <elena@finspire.com>
Date: 2027-05-14T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Production latency spike tonight — request for compensation

Quick summary from infra: we saw a routing flurry between two model serving pools that increased queue wait times for requests with >1024 tokens. Root cause appears to be a buggy autoscaler backoff combined with a recent kernel optimization that regressed tail latency.

Planned immediate actions:
- Roll back the kernel change in the next 30m (in progress)
- Recalibrate autoscaler thresholds and add conservative caps to prevent recurrence
- Deliver a concise postmortem (internal draft attached: postmortem-draft.md) within 48–72 hours

Regarding the gesture — 5k tokens is a light, fast gesture we can grant immediately from our promo pool. If sales wants a stronger customer-facing package (more tokens + trial extension), we can authorize up to 15k tokens with manager ok. Recommend: 10k tokens + 14-day extension as a balanced offer.

Marcus Lin
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-14T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal review — Finspire offer

Thanks for the analysis. For a customer with production impact and revenue exposure, I approve a customer-facing offer of up to 12k tokens plus a 14-day trial extension. Please do not promise more than 12k without exec sign-off.

Jordan — craft the external wording to emphasize: apologies, root cause being investigated, concrete remediation steps, and the token/extension as an immediate gesture while we complete the postmortem. Include legal-friendly terms in the attachment (credit_terms.pdf).

Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Sales Operations
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena@finspire.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-14T14:08:00-07:00
Subject: Formal offer: token boost + trial extension for incident on 2027-05-14

Elena —

First, thank you for the heads-up and for sending the log. I'm very sorry for the interruption last night. We take incidents like this seriously.

Here is our immediate offer while we finish the postmortem: 
- 10,000 token credit applied to Finspire's account within 24 hours (usable across models)
- 14-day extension of your trial period
- Postmortem delivered within 72 hours and 1:1 review with Marcus to walk through remediation steps

I've attached the short credit terms for your review (credit_terms.pdf). If that looks acceptable I can trigger the credit and update your HubSpot deal. For formal acceptance, please reply-to-all with confirmation and we will mark the gesture fulfilled.

Thanks again,

Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: credit_terms.pdf
From: Elena Soto <elena@finspire.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-16T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Formal offer: token boost + trial extension for incident on 2027-05-14

Jordan —

Thank you, that offer is acceptable. We appreciate the quick response and the remediation plan. Please proceed with the 10k token credit and the 14-day extension. We look forward to the postmortem and the 1:1 with Marcus.

Best,
Elena Soto
Head of Platform Ops, Finspire
